CLAIM TYPE: Property - hail damage to roof and detached garage

DESCRIPTION OF LOSS:
On March 14, 2026, a severe hailstorm damaged the asphalt shingle roof and the
detached garage of the insured property in Madison, Wisconsin.

COVERAGE DETERMINATION: APPROVED. Payment issued under the dwelling and other
structures coverage. No denial reasons apply.

SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS: photos of roof and garage damage; contractor estimate
